story: Context
Cool Harvest Farms needed a food range that could feel familiar on the shelf while giving every product a clear place within one growing brand.
Visual direction
The system uses a calm farm led identity, warm product photography and strong product names so shoppers can understand the range at a glance.
Design decisions
Bottle, pouch and jar formats share the same brand structure while colour, product imagery and pack size help each item stay easy to identify.
Applications
The supplied presentations cover Honey Beans (Ewa Oloyin), red oil, Chin Chin, Garri Ijebu, groundnut, cray fish, plantain chips and hot pepper across a connected packaging range.
